individual de multiplos objetos e falta de tecnicas de batching (agrupamento), instanciamento de malhas ou combinacao estatica/dinamica.","codigo_refatorado":"using System.Collections.Generic;\\nusing UnityEngine;\\n\\n[RequireComponent(typeof(MeshFilter), typeof(MeshRenderer))]\\npublic class RuntimeMeshCombiner : MonoBehaviour\\n{\\n    [SerializeField] private bool destroyOriginals = true;\\n\\n    [ContextMenu(\\\"Combinar Malhas\\\")]\\n    public void CombineMeshes()\\n    {\\n        MeshFilter[] meshFilters = GetComponentsInChildren<MeshFilter>(false);\\n        Dictionary<Material, List<CombineInstance>> materialToCombineInstances = new Dictionary<Material, List<CombineInstance>>();\\n\\n        Matrix4x4 myTransformMatrix = transform.worldToLocalMatrix;\\n\\n        for (int i = 0; i < meshFilters.Length; i++)\\n        {\\n            MeshFilter mf = meshFilters[i];\\n            if (mf == this.GetComponent<MeshFilter>()) continue;\\n\\n            MeshRenderer mr = mf.GetComponent<MeshRenderer>();\\n            if (mr == null || !mr.enabled || mf.sharedMesh == null) continue;\\n\\n            Material[] mats = mr.sharedMaterials;\\n            for (int sub = 0; sub < mf.sharedMesh.subMeshCount; sub++)\\n            {\\n                if (sub >= mats.Length) break;\\n                Material mat = mats[sub];\\n                if (mat == null) continue;\\n\\n                if (!materialToCombineInstances.ContainsKey(mat))\\n                {\\n                    materialToCombineInstances[mat] = new List<CombineInstance>();\\n                }\\n\\n                CombineInstance ci = new CombineInstance();\\n                ci.mesh = mf.sharedMesh;\\n                ci.subMeshIndex = sub;\\n                ci.transform = myTransformMatrix * mf.transform.localToWorldMatrix;\\n                materialToCombineInstances[mat].Add(ci);\\n            }\\n\\n            if (destroyOriginals)\\n            {\\n                Destroy(mr);\\n                Destroy(mf);\\n            }\\n            else\\n            {\\n                mr.enabled = false;\\n            }\\n        }\\n\\n        List<Material> finalMaterials = new List<Material>();\\n        List<CombineInstance> finalCombine = new List<CombineInstance>();\\n\\n        foreach (KeyValuePair<Material, List<CombineInstance>> entry in materialToCombineInstances)\\n        {\\n            Mesh subMeshCombined = new Mesh();\\n            subMeshCombined.indexFormat = UnityEngine.Rendering.IndexFormat.UInt32;\\n            subMeshCombined.CombineMeshes(entry.Value.ToArray(), true, true);\\n\\n            CombineInstance ci = new CombineInstance();\\n            ci.mesh = subMeshCombined;\\n            ci.subMeshIndex = 0;\\n            ci.transform = Matrix4x4.identity;\\n\\n            finalCombine.Add(ci);\\n            finalMaterials.Add(entry.Key);\\n        }\\n\\n        Mesh finalMesh = new Mesh();\\n        finalMesh.name = \\\"CombinedMesh_\\\" + gameObject.name;\\n        finalMesh.indexFormat = UnityEngine.Rendering.IndexFormat.UInt32;\\n        finalMesh.CombineMeshes(finalCombine.ToArray(), false, false);\\n\\n        GetComponent<MeshFilter>().sharedMesh = finalMesh;\\n        GetComponent<MeshRenderer>().sharedMaterials = finalMaterials.ToArray();\\n    }\\n}","explicacao_didatica":"Pense nos Draw Calls como viagens que o entregador (CPU) faz ate a cozinha (GPU) para pedir um prato por vez. Em vez de pedir 13 mil pratos em 13 mil viagens separadas, este script junta varios objetos que usam os mesmos materiais em um unico prato grande. Assim, a CPU faz uma unica entrega contendo tudo agrupado, reduzindo drasticamente o numero de chamadas e aliviando a placa de video."}],"dicas_level_design":"1. Occlusion Culling: Configure e asse (bake) o Occlusion Culling na cena para que geometrias e objetos ocultos atras de paredes nao sejam enviados para renderizacao. 2. Static Batching e Flags: Marque todos os elementos cenicos estaticos (predios, rochas, props) com a flag 'Batching Static' no Inspector. 3. Texture Atlasing e Compartilhamento de Materiais: Consolide multiplas texturas de objetos pequenos em um unico Texture Atlas para diminuir a variacao de materiais. 4. GPU Instancing e LOD Groups: Habilite 'Enable GPU Instancing' nos materiais de vegetacao e objetos repetidos, e configure LOD Groups com distancias agressivas de culling para descartar detalhes menores a media e longa distancia."}
